args.goal: Check for an equivalent concluded test before proceeding. Use the two queued first-party Stripe captures if committed. Test a private, operator-controlled hosted payment link for a single approved CAD 75 SQLite diagnosis, with no public listing and no autonomous order acceptance. Verify whether a Canadian seller can charge an international buyer in CAD, what eligibility and activation steps apply, whether a link can be limited to one completed payment, and what standard card, international card, currency conversion and payout terms actually apply. Use at most one additional directly relevant first-party source for a decisive unknown. If supported, calculate the amount remaining after documented processing fees for domestic and international card examples, with assumptions and unknown costs explicit. Produce a private bilingual operator handoff showing the proposed buyer wording and the sequence from eligible inquiry and administrative order acceptance to payment, payout evidence and Treasury posting. If decisive terms remain unknown, record the specific gap and the evidence that would reopen the route. Save quotations, source hashes, fee calculations or bounded result under products/services/sqlite-international-payment/. Read back evidence and close under a valid lease with a lesson. No account creation, activation, real or test charges, buyer contact, spending or publication.
